families.name: Claims Lifecycle
families.description: Reconstructs claim registration, updates, status transitions, resolution outcomes, and finalization.

families.name: Evidence Management
families.description: Tracks content-addressed evidence commitments, revocations, and claim evidence window closures.

families.name: Staking & Collateral Accounting
families.description: Reconciles verifier collateral deposits, round locking, unlocking, and withdrawals.

families.name: Verification & Voting
families.description: Records individual verifier submissions, support verdicts, committed stakes, and challenges.

families.name: Rounds Management
families.description: Defines round lifecycle windows, participant counts, and weighted vote totals.

families.name: Outcomes & Consensus Aggregation
families.description: Tracks deterministic aggregation of weighted verifications, consensus verdict, and confidence scores.

families.name: Dispute Resolution
families.description: Reconstructs dispute challenges, escalation bonds, rulings, and resulting outcome overrides.

families.name: Reward Calculation & Distribution
families.description: Reconciles deterministic reward calculations, escrow reservations, claims, and batch payouts.

families.name: Slashing Penalties
families.description: Reconciles collateral slashing for losing votes or Byzantine behaviour across individual and batch flows.

families.name: Withdrawal Queue & Timelocks
families.description: Tracks queueing, cooldown expiry, cancellations, and execution of large verifier withdrawals.

families.name: Treasury Accounting & Solvency
families.description: Maintains full double-entry reconciliation of deposits, internal bucket transfers, withdrawals, and snapshots.

families.name: Protocol Parameters & Schedules
families.description: Tracks versioned governance parameter updates, address reconfigurations, and fee schedule updates.

families.name: Reputation Roots & Snapshots
families.description: Publishes cross-chain Merkle roots, individual score adjustments, and decay updates.

families.name: Access Control & Roles
families.description: Tracks role granting, revocation, and admin role hierarchy changes across protocol modules.

families.name: Emergency Controls & Pauses
families.description: Reconstructs protocol emergency pause activation and recovery events.

families.name: Upgrades & Version Management
families.description: Reconstructs module registrations, upgrade proposals, approvals, executions, and rollbacks.
